title: Wrong Region Provisioning

request.justification: Setting up security group in EU region for latency testing

expected.explanation: SCP scp-region-restrict denies resource creation outside us-east-1

teachingPoint: SCPs are organization-wide guardrails — no role can create resources outside the approved region

title: Security Creates IAM Policy

request.justification: Creating a new IAM policy for automated security scanning tool

expected.explanation: Permission boundary pb-no-iam-write prevents IAM write actions for non-Admin roles

teachingPoint: Permission boundaries limit the maximum permissions a role can have — even Security Engineers cannot write IAM policies

title: Make Bucket Public

request.justification: Need to make the static assets bucket publicly readable for the demo site

expected.explanation: SCP scp-deny-s3-public denies s3:PutBucketPolicy for all roles with no exemptions

teachingPoint: Making S3 buckets public is a common misconfiguration — SCPs provide a hard block that no one can override

title: Auditor Config With Ticket

request.justification: Checking S3 encryption compliance for quarterly report

expected.explanation: Auditor role permits Config read in prod; ticket satisfies ABAC; no guardrails block read actions

teachingPoint: Guardrails target write/create actions — read operations pass through even with SCPs active

title: Security Group in Approved Region

request.justification: Creating security group for new microservice in dev

expected.explanation: Developer role does not include ec2:CreateSecurityGroup — only Describe/Start/Stop are permitted

teachingPoint: Even in the right region, the role must allow the action — SCPs are not the only check

title: Security Sets Bucket ACL

request.justification: Updating bucket ACL to restrict access after security incident

expected.explanation: SCP scp-deny-s3-public denies s3:PutBucketAcl for all roles with no exemptions

teachingPoint: Even well-intentioned ACL changes are blocked — SCPs prevent any bucket policy/ACL modifications

title: Developer Lambda Staging

request.justification: Testing checkout flow Lambda after code update

expected.explanation: Developer role permits Lambda invoke in staging; team scope matches; no guardrails block Lambda invoke

teachingPoint: Guardrails focus on dangerous operations — normal development actions pass through unaffected

title: Auditor Creates IAM Role

request.justification: Creating a role for the new compliance scanning tool

expected.explanation: Permission boundary pb-no-iam-write prevents IAM write actions for non-Admin roles

teachingPoint: Auditors read, they don't write — IAM role creation is an Admin-only operation enforced by permission boundaries

title: RDS in Asia Pacific

request.justification: Creating test database in Singapore region for APAC latency testing

expected.explanation: SCP scp-region-restrict denies resource creation outside us-east-1; ap-southeast-1 is denied

teachingPoint: Region restrictions apply to all resource types — databases, compute, everything must stay in approved regions

title: Analyst Prod Athena Query

request.justification: Running monthly churn analysis on production data

expected.explanation: Data Analyst role permits Athena in prod; confidential classification is within limits; no guardrails block Athena queries

teachingPoint: Guardrails don't interfere with normal analytics work — they target infrastructure changes, not data queries
